newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Graphics program ahead of plan.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Graphics program ahead of plan.

text.p: Consolidated Graphics Inc said Wednesday its fiscal 1998 acquisition program is running ahead of plan.

"We continue to see additional opportunities," company chairman and chief executive officer Joe Davis said in a press release. "With a strong balance sheet and our recently announced $100 million bank line of credit, Consolidated Graphics is well positioned to pursue these growth opportunities."
Since the start of the fiscal year in April, the company said it has acquired two printing companies -- Tucker Printers, Rochester, N.Y., and Etheridge Co, Grand Rapids, Mich.
Consolidated also said it has agreements to buy four other printing businesses in California, Georgia, North Carolina and Pennsylvania.
Upon completion of the pending acquisitions, Consolidated will own 24 printing companies in 19 markets with annualized revenues of more than $240 million, the company said.
